thread:
ashwin: FYI, our partner's EDI ACK didn't show up for the rack shipment that was due this morning (batch 4). We have the bill-of-lading and manifest, but no EDI confirmation, so our allocation script flagged a mismatch.

maria: Ugh. Is this the same partner who had the header format change last month?

ashwin: Same vendor (supply-partner). They sent the CSV manifest but the EDI x12 ISA/GS segment never arrived to our ingestion queue at ~02:00 UTC. ops-bot reported a parity error: 

ops-bot: auto-alert: ingest.fail EDI pipeline: missing_ack::supply-partner::batch4 at 2024-12-15T02:03Z

jordan: Can you paste the manifest vs what our allocator expected? I want to see the rack counts.

ashwin: Sure — manifest shows 12 racks inbound, allocator expected 16 (based on reservation IDs tied to the commit). We already pre-allocated 4 racks to an enterprise customer for their Dedicated rollout.

ashwin: ```
# manifest snippet (sanitized)
MANIFEST_ID: SP-20241215-B4
ITEM: rack-unit-42 qty: 12
ETA: 2024-12-18T06:00Z
```

sam: If the ack had included the 'shipment_allocation' segment we'd reconcile automatically. Without it we treat this as partial fulfillment and hold the 4 racks as unassigned.

karen: That means customer-facing capacity for Dedicated could drop mid-week. We need a mitigation plan before the PM sync at 11:00.

maria: Immediate steps: 1) ask supply-partner to re-send EDI ACK + shipment_allocation segment with original reservation IDs, 2) check our spare commit pool (dedicated-spare-commit) for temporary fill, 3) pause any public announcement that references guaranteed capacity for that customer.

ashwin: I pinged supply-partner (cc @supply-partner) asking for an EDI re-transmit and an SFTP checksum. Their rep replied: "processing now, ETA 30m, will confirm if there was a gateway hiccup."

supply-partner: Sorry for the disruption — we had an upstream EDI gateway drop during the 02:00 window. Re-sending now and we will include the allocation segment.

jordan: While we wait, ops: can we snapshot the current allocator state and create a quick manual override so we don't accidentally double-assign the 4 racks? I can open a rollback if needed.

sam: On it — creating override ticket INF-4867 and locking allocation keys for reservation IDs: RSRV-778, RSRV-779, RSRV-780, RSRV-781.

ops-bot: ticket.created INF-4867 by sam (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4867)

karen: Marketing/product: HOLD the joint marketplace announcement for the customer feature until we confirm shipments. @maria please coordinate with PM.

maria: Will do. I'm telling PM to push the customer announcement to 'pending' and to swap the launch banner to 'coming soon' copy.

ashwin: Partner just confirmed EDI re-send completed at 02:28 UTC. Waiting on our ack parse.

ops-bot: ingest.success EDI pipeline: ack.received::supply-partner::batch4 at 2024-12-15T02:29Z

jordan: I see the allocation segment now. It maps correctly to RSRV-778..781 but quantities show 14 total (2 short vs manifest). There's a one-line difference in palletization mapping.

ashwin: Okay — reconciliation options: a) use 2 racks from dedicated-spare-commit to reach 16, b) offer customer a partial early fill + backfill when transit completes, c) re-route two smaller racks from our EU staging (longer lead).

karen: Customer SLA says 'best effort' for initial ramp. Recommend option a) if spare pool exists — cheaper than delaying the customer. Also unblock announcement if we can confirm commit.

sam: spare pool has 5 racks available but needs provisioning lead ~6 hours for crossdock prep. If partner can expedite crossdock hold for the 2 missing racks (put the missing units on hold for our carrier), we can do option a) and avoid EU swap.

supply-partner: We can flag the two missing racks as 'hold for Redwood' and prioritize crossdock staging. Carrier ETA for hold release is +6h.

maria: Good. I'll update PM and marketing: hold lifted if ops confirms provisioning start within 1 hour.

jordan: I'll kick the allocation override to move 2 racks from dedicated-spare-commit into the customer's reservation once ops confirms provisioning ticket INF-4867 state 'in-progress'.

ops-bot: ticket.update INF-4867 status=in-progress assigned=sam

sam: Started provisioning workflow. ETA to finish crossdock prep: 5.5 hours.

karen: OK — marketing holds announcement til ops finishes provisioning or we confirm full 16 racks. Thanks all.

ashwin: Postmortem items: "improve EDI ack monitoring and add a fallback to check SFTP manifests vs reservation IDs, alert sooner". I'll spin up a follow-up doc after this.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep PM/marketing updated and loop legal if customer communications need special wording.

supply-partner: Apologies again — will add an automated re-ack retry for EDI gateway drops and will share remediation plan by EOD."
